translation.name: Godɨn Eghaghanim: Akar Gavgavir Dɨkɨrɨzir Ghurim ko Igiam

book.name: Onger Akaba
book.title: Godɨn Ziam Fer Onger Akabar Akɨnafarim O Onger Akaba

content.text: Gumazim, Godɨn Bar Pɨn Itim, deragh an gansɨ an a bagh mangɨtɨ,
God deragh an ganam.
A Godɨn Gavgaviba Bar Itimɨn boroghɨn ikɨtɨ,
God dughuazimɨn mɨn anevaragham.
Gumazir kam Ikiavɨra Godɨn mɨkɨm suam,
“Nɨ nan dɨvazir gavgavimɨn mɨn itima,
kɨ nɨn aven uabɨ moga deravɨra iti.
Nɨ nan God.
Kɨ nɨghnɨzir gavgavim nɨrara iti.”
Bar guizbangɨra, God bar deragh nɨ geghuv nɨn gantɨ,
Bizir kuratam azuazimɨn mɨn modogh ikɨ,
nɨn suiragh nɨ gasɨghasighan kogham.
Nɨ an dafarimɨn aven ikɨtɨ,
arɨmariar kuratam nɨ inightɨ,
nɨ aremeghan kogham.
A tuarir amebam uan nguziba ave moghɨn,
uan avɨzimningɨn nɨ avaraghtɨ nɨ aven ikiam.
Kamaghɨra, nɨ Ikiavɨra Itir God, an apengan ikɨtɨ
a deravɨra nɨ modogh nɨ geghuv nɨn ganam.
A ifarir puvatɨ.
A zurara uan akar a mɨkemezibar gɨn mangɨ,
nɨn oramɨn mɨn ikɨ,
deravɨra nɨn ganam.
Dɨmagaribar aruir duar kuraba, nɨ dar atiatingan markɨ.
Nɨ aruemɨn, bizir zuamɨra nɨ gasɨghasɨzi tamɨn atiatingan kogham.
Nɨ arɨmariar ekiar dɨmangan nɨ bativamiba,
ko bizir kurar aruemɨn nɨ gasɨghasɨghamibar
atiatingan kogham.
Gumazir 1,000pla nɨn boroghɨn arɨmɨghireghtɨ,
10,000pla nɨn agharir guvimɨn arɨghiregham, eghtɨ nɨ deragham.
Bizir kuratam nɨn boroghɨn izan kogham.
Nɨ gantɨ arazir kurar gumaziba nɨ gamiba,
God uam ada ikarvagham.
Nɨ bizir kurabar atiatia Ikiavɨra Itir God bagha zui.
Godɨn Bar Pɨn Itim, a nɨn dɨvazimɨn mɨn ikia,
guizbangɨra nɨ geghuva nɨn gari.
Kamaghɨn, bizir kuratam nɨ bagh izan kogham.
Arɨmariar ekiatam nɨn dɨpenimɨn boroghɨn mangan kogham.
Nɨ daruamin dughiabar,
Ikiavɨra Itir God, nɨ bagh uan enselba Akar Gavgavim me mɨkɨmtɨma,
me deraghvɨra nɨn ganam.
Egh me uan dafaribar nɨ fueghtɨ,
nɨ uan dagarim dagɨatamɨn aneseghan kogham.
Nɨ laionba ko, kuruziba ko, laionɨn igiaba ko,
kuruzir kurar ekiaba dɨkabɨnam.
God kamaghɨn mɨgɨa ghaze,
“Gumazir nan ziam gɨfogha na gifongegha nan poroziba,
kɨ ua me inigh,
deragh me geghuv men ganam.
Eghtɨ me na ko mɨkɨmtɨ, kɨ me baragham.
Egh osɨmtɨzim me batoghtɨ kɨ me ko ikɨva,
ua me inigh ziar ekiam me danɨngam.
Egh kɨ men ikɨrɨmɨrim men ivezimɨn mɨn a damightɨ
a mangɨ ruaragham, egh kɨ uamategh me inigh me ko ikiam.
Egh kɨ ua me inigh
men Akurvazir Gumazimɨn ikiam.”
